method: Join the independently verified register archive to published ministry/hearing resources by identical binary SHA256. Different PDF covers or metadata may prevent a match even for the same authored response.
limitations: No match is not evidence of no submission or no same-authored version.
An exact binary match does not establish a recipient timestamp independently of the self-reported register event.
Ministry master omissions and BMF access barriers remain; this does not close the full population.
This crosswalk is source reconciliation, not a substantive claim screen.
